image_description: A vintage white minibus (resembling a Fiat 600 Multipla) parked outdoors with green foliage in the background. A man in a white shirt is crouching near the front left wheel, holding what appears to be a wooden prop or tool. The vehicle features a distinctive rounded front end, large headlights, and a split windshield.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the height is adequate for a microvan, the entrance door configuration is not clearly visible as a standard sliding/folding bus door; the front fascia design suggests automotive doors rather than a dedicated bus entrance.
The angle of the image and the position of the man obscure the side of the vehicle where the door would be located. It is impossible to verify the mechanism.
